svg.aria-label: An isometric pull request line on a base plate. Parcels standing for pull requests leave an intake hopper, ride a conveyor under a review station with a stamp and a dial, and end in a green tray when merged or wait in a red-outlined tray while under review. 15 merged, 22 under review, 41 % merged. By project: Symfony 15 merged, 1 under review; API Platform 0 merged, 8 under review; API Platform installer 0 merged, 2 under review; Caddy 0 merged, 8 under review; Ting 0 merged, 3 under review.
svg.title: 15 merged and 22 under review open source pull requests
svg.text: Fig. 4 — Pull request line: every parcel is reviewed (2), merged ones land in the tray (3).
